info.title: API.SH: Amtrak
info.description: The Amtrak API from API.SH: public Amtrak data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
Every Amtrak train on the live map right now: number, route, origin, destination, position (latitude, longitude), heading, speed, next station, last update, and each stop with scheduled, estimated and actual times (station local time) and on-time notes. Filter by train number or route; `routes` lists the route names.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/amtrak-live-trains

parameters.name: route
parameters.description: Keep routes whose name contains this text, e.g. `acela`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every Amtrak trip between two stations on a day: departure and arrival (local times), duration, changes, and for each train its number, route, distance, days of operation, amenities, classes (Coach, Business, Roomette, Bedroom and others), bike and pet space, and every stop with times. Fares are not included.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/amtrak-schedules

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Travel day, YYYY-MM-DD. Give this or `days_ahead`.

parameters.name: days_ahead
parameters.description: Travel day as days from today (0-365), when `date` is not given.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Amtrak station: address, ticket office, waiting room and baggage hours, baggage services, accessibility, facilities (Wi-Fi, restrooms, ATMs and more), parking, taxis, lounges, Thruway connections, directions and the station's contacts block as Amtrak publishes it. Unknown codes answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/amtrak-station

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every Amtrak train calling at a station on a day, with scheduled and estimated or actual arrival and departure times, status and delay, route and the train's origin and destination. Sorted by departure (or arrival) time; filter by train numbers.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/amtrak-station-status

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: `departure` (default) or `arrival`: which time the day refers to.

parameters.name: train_numbers
parameters.description: Comma-separated train numbers to keep, e.g. `19,20`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every Amtrak station and bus stop: code, name, facility, city, state, time zone and aliases. Filter by text or state.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/amtrak-stations

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text to match in the code, name, city or aliases, e.g. `boston`.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Two-letter state or province code, e.g. `MA`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Live status of an Amtrak train on a day: route, origin and destination, a summary, last known location with coordinates, and every stop with scheduled and estimated or actual arrival and departure times and delays. Trains that do not run that day answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/amtrak-train-status

parameters.name: days_ahead
parameters.description: Service day as days from today (-1 for yesterday).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

origin.name: New York, NY
origin.facility: Moynihan Train Hall at Penn Sta.

get.summary: Amtrak live status between two stations
get.description:
Every Amtrak trip between two stations on a day with live departure and arrival status at both ends: scheduled and estimated or actual times, delay and status, for each train of the trip.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/amtrak-trip-status

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
